sections.s1_content: These guidelines say what can be posted and done on CircleSfera. They apply to everything: posts, stories, Frames, comments, messages and lives.
sections.s2_content: Harassment, hate speech, threats and discrimination are not allowed. You can disagree with someone; you cannot attack them.
sections.s3_content: Do not post illegal or explicit content. Child sexual abuse material, credible threats of violence and terrorism lead to an immediate ban of the profile.
sections.s4_title: 4. Be who you say you are
sections.s4_content: Do not impersonate other people or use fake accounts. Do not send spam or use tools to inflate followers, likes or views. An automated account has to be labelled as one.
sections.s5_content: Post content that is yours or that you have the right to share.
sections.s6_content: If you charge for your content, deliver what you promise. Misleading offers are not allowed. Paid content and promotions follow the same rules as everything else.
sections.s7_content: You can report a post, a comment, a story, a message or a profile from its menu. A person on our team reviews every report.
sections.s8_title: 8. What happens if you break the rules
sections.s8_content:
• A first minor violation gets a warning with no consequences; later ones get strikes.
• With 2 active strikes the profile is suspended for 7 days. With 3, it is banned.
• Each warning and strike expires after 90 days.
• Severe violations can lead to an immediate ban.
• The sanction applies to the profile that broke the rules, not to your other profiles, except in severe cases.
• We always tell you which rule was applied and why.
sections.s9_content: If you think we got it wrong, you can appeal any decision from Settings → Appeals. A person reviews it, and if you are right the sanction is withdrawn and what was removed is restored.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy - CircleSfera
privacy.header_subtitle: How we protect your data in the CircleSfera universe.

sections.s1_content: CircleSfera is the controller of your data. For any privacy matter, or to exercise your rights, write to legal@circlesfera.com.
sections.s2_content:
• Account: email address, password (stored hashed), date of birth and sign-in methods (2FA, passkeys).
• Profile and content: username, name, bio, photo, posts, stories, comments, reactions, followers and direct messages (encrypted on our servers).
• Payments: if you buy or get paid, your Stripe identifiers and transaction history. Your card details are handled by Stripe; we never see them.
• Security: the IP address you signed up with and your last sign-in IP, your sign-up country and a device fingerprint that we only store as an irreversible keyed hash.
• Activity: interactions in the app, views and searches.
sections.s3_content:
• To provide the service (account, profile, content, messages and payments): performance of the contract.
• To protect the platform from spam, bots, fake accounts and abuse: legitimate interest (see section 4).
• To moderate content with the help of artificial intelligence and human review: legitimate interest and legal obligations.
• To improve the app and measure its use: legitimate interest. Error monitoring only runs if you accept analytics cookies.
• To meet the tax and accounting obligations of payments: legal obligation.
sections.s4_content:
To protect the community, an automated system assesses each profile's activity (for example, many actions in a short time, the same message sent many times or several accounts from the same device) and calculates a risk score. We do not keep the text of your messages for this: only a keyed fingerprint for 24 hours.
• If the score is high, a person on our team reviews the case and decides. Sanctions (warnings, strikes, suspensions, bans and the bot label) are always decided by a person.
• If the score is very high, the system may temporarily limit how many accounts you can follow and how many people you can message for the first time (20 and 5 a day) for at most 72 hours while it is reviewed. Nothing is hidden or removed. We tell you it was automated, and you can appeal.
• You can object to this processing and appeal any decision from Settings → Appeals.
sections.s5_title: 5. Who we share your data with
sections.s5_content: Only with providers that deliver the service on our behalf: Stripe (payments and identity verification), OpenAI (moderation, search and accessibility features), Cloudflare (bot protection), Brevo (email), Sentry (errors, with your consent), LiveKit and Metered (live video and calls), Mapbox (maps) and OVH (hosting in the European Union). Some process data in the United States; those transfers rely on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or on the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission, depending on the provider. We do not sell your data.
sections.s6_content:
• Account and content: while you have the account. If you delete it, we erase it permanently after 30 days.
• Activity, views and searches: 90 days.
• Full IP addresses: 90 days after they are recorded; after that we only keep an irreversible keyed version to detect linked accounts.
• Device fingerprints: up to 180 days without use.
• Warnings and strikes: they stop counting after 90 days and are deleted 12 months later, unless they still cause a ban or suspension in force.
• Spam review cases: 12 months after they close. Resolved reports: 2 years.
• Payment data: as long as tax and accounting law requires.
sections.s7_content: You can access, correct and delete your data, restrict or object to its processing and ask for its portability. In Settings you can download your data and delete your account. For anything else, write to legal@circlesfera.com. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
sections.s8_content: We use cookies needed for your session and security. Analytics cookies (error monitoring) only run if you accept them, and you can change your choice at any time.
sections.s9_content: If we change this policy in a meaningful way, we will tell you in the app.

sections.s1_content: CircleSfera is a social network. By creating an account you accept these terms, the Privacy Policy and the Community Guidelines. Contact: legal@circlesfera.com.
sections.s2_content: You must be at least 16 years old. You are responsible for the security of your account and for what is done with it. An account can have several profiles; each profile must follow these terms.
sections.s3_content: The content you post is yours. You grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide licence to host, display, adapt to different formats and distribute it within the service for as long as you keep it published. You confirm that you have the right to post it.
sections.s4_content: You may not post illegal content, harass others, impersonate other people, send spam, use fake accounts or automated accounts without labelling them, or try to get around security measures. The Community Guidelines describe what is not allowed.
sections.s5_content:
• You can report content or profiles. A person on our team reviews reports.
• A first minor violation gets a warning with no consequences; later ones get strikes. With 2 active strikes the profile is suspended for 7 days, and with 3 it is banned. Each warning and strike expires after 90 days. Severe violations can lead to an immediate ban.
• Sanctions apply to the profile that broke the rules, not to your other profiles, except in severe cases (illegal content, evading an earlier ban or an order from an authority).
• An automated system detects spam activity and can temporarily limit, for up to 72 hours, how many accounts you can follow and how many people you can message while a person reviews it.
• We always explain the reason for each decision, and you can appeal it from Settings → Appeals.
sections.s6_content: We offer monthly plans (Premium, Elite Creator and Business) with the features and prices shown in the app. They are charged in advance through Stripe and renew every month until you cancel. If you cancel, the plan stays active until the end of the paid period.
sections.s7_content:
• Creator and Business accounts with a verified identity can receive tips (from €2), sell paid posts, stories and messages (from €3 to €500), and receive live gifts.
• CircleSfera keeps 20% of each payment and the creator receives 80% through Stripe Connect, subject to Stripe's terms.
• Creators are responsible for the taxes on what they earn.
• Paid content must follow these rules.
sections.s8_content: You can promote content with a budget. The promotion must follow these rules; if we reject it, we refund the amount.
sections.s9_content: You can deactivate or delete your account at any time from Settings; we erase it permanently after 30 days. We can suspend or close profiles or accounts that break these terms, as described in section 5.
sections.s10_content: We provide the service with due care, but we cannot guarantee that it always works without interruptions. We are not responsible for content posted by other people, except where the law provides otherwise.
sections.s11_content: If we change these terms in a meaningful way, we will tell you in the app in advance.
sections.s12_content: These terms are governed by Spanish law. If you are a consumer, you can go to the courts of your place of residence.

seo.title: CircleSfera — Your World, Connected.
seo.description: CircleSfera is a social network for posts, stories, Frames, Direct, and Live. You choose what you see and who can reach you.

hero.lead: A social network built to give you more control.
hero.subtitle: Share, discover content, connect with other people and build your community, knowing how the platform works. You decide what you see, who you connect with and how you live it.

features.title: Everything you share, in one place.
features.subtitle: Posts, stories, short video, messages and live, with a single account.

feed.title: Feed and Stories
feed.headline: Share your day in posts and stories
feed.desc: Post photos and videos, add stories that disappear and keep the ones you want on your profile.

frames.title: Frames
frames.headline: Discover short videos in Frames
frames.desc: Full-screen vertical video, with the same account and the same people.

direct.title: Direct
direct.headline: Talk in private with Direct
direct.desc: Messages with the people you choose, without leaving CircleSfera.

live.title: Live
live.headline: Go live and talk with your audience
live.desc: Real-time chat and gifts to support whoever is broadcasting.

creator.title: Creator tools
creator.headline: Earn from what you create
creator.desc: Tips, paid content and live gifts, with Stripe. The platform fee is 20% and prices are shown before you pay.

principles.title: Your experience, your rules.
principles.subtitle: Five principles guide how CircleSfera is designed.

control.title: User Control
control.desc: You decide what you see, who can interact with you and which recommendations you get. Automation helps; it does not override your choices.

transparency.title: Algorithmic Transparency
transparency.desc: What shows up in For you and Explore has to be explainable: why you see it and how to change it.

no_suppression.title: No Hidden Suppression
no_suppression.desc: We do not limit the reach of your content behind your back. When a rule limits its visibility, that rule has to be understandable.

moderation.title: Explainable Moderation
moderation.desc: The rules are public. You can report content and appeal a decision from Settings.

data.title: Responsible Data Handling
data.desc: We keep what the product needs, and we must be able to say why. Exporting and deleting your data is in Settings.

cta.title: Start on CircleSfera today
cta.subtitle: Create your free account and share with the people you care about.

features.seo_desc: Feed, stories, Frames, Direct, Live, and creator tools — one CircleSfera account.

principles.seo_desc: User control, why you see what you see, clear moderation, and responsible data handling.

footer.desc: A social network built to give you more control.
